---
title: "Portfolio 6"
---

The goal of this portfolio piece is to build on my previous work with the PTSD Repository by exploring a new way to analyze the dataset. In this project, I examine the distribution of study designs to gain a broader understanding of the overall research landscape. By focusing on study design, I aim to better understand the types of evidence that make up the PTSD treatment literature by moving from the content of research (what treatments exist) to the quality of research (how treatments are studied)
